content:
NGC 4571 is a galaxy located in the constellation of Virgo. It is part of the Virgo Cluster, which is a large cluster of galaxies in our local galactic neighborhood. It is classified as a spiral galaxy, specifically as an SABc type galaxy, which means it has a weak bar structure and somewhat loosely wound spiral arms. 

Beyond these basic facts, I do not want to state anything else about NGC 4571 without being certain of its accuracy. My knowledge about this specific galaxy is limited, and I prefer to be transparent about the extent of my information rather than potentially providing incorrect details.
